item.title: Attackers Begin Scanning for Oracle E-Business Suite Flaw CVE-2026-101767
item.description: Threat intelligence firm Defused recorded exploratory attacks against the critical bug days after Oracle's October 20 patch; Oracle has not tagged it as exploited.

item.title: Apple Releases iOS 27.2 With Siri AI in Five New Languages and 160-Plus Security Fixes
item.description: The update adds Siri AI memory features, FaceTime accessibility tools and Apple TV Multiview, and backports fixes to older iOS versions.

item.title: Anduril and Qualcomm Announce BlueChip, a US-Made Rugged Laptop
item.description: The Snapdragon X-based machine targets government buyers, with preorders planned for 2027 and about 90% of parts from the US or allied countries.

item.title: Microsoft Offers Voluntary Exit Packages to About 60,000 Employees
item.description: The "Voluntary Exit Offer" covers staff at vice president level and below on select teams in four countries, with terms similar to standard severance.

item.title: Meta Launches $35 Billion Stock Offering as Part of Up to $95 Billion Equity Raise for AI
item.description: A further $60 billion at-the-market program in new non-voting Class C shares is planned for 2027; Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom have expressed non-binding interest in up to $5 billion of stock.

item.title: Anthropic Files for IPO, Reporting $16.3 Billion in First-Half Revenue
item.description: The filing, reported by TechCrunch, shows an $80.7 billion net loss driven largely by noncash charges and a governance structure that gives seven co-founders 50.1% of the vote.

item.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Terra, a Cheaper Model for Computer Use
item.description: The smaller model is priced at $1 per million input tokens and $5 per million output tokens, and OpenAI says it completes tasks more than three times faster than its larger models.

item.title: Microsoft Ships Out-of-Band Windows Updates to Distrust eMudhra Certificates
item.description: Updates KB5134133 and KB5134125 remove seven certificates from the Windows trust list after researchers found weak private keys in eight eMudhra intermediate CAs.

item.title: Microsoft Issues Emergency .NET Patches for Critical Brotli Flaw
item.description: CVE-2026-111497 is an out-of-bounds write in the Brotli decoder; proof-of-concept exploits are public, but no in-the-wild attacks had been reported.

item.title: Apple Unveils OLED iPad mini With A20 Pro Chip, From $699
item.description: The 8.5-inch tablet is 5.4 mm thick, with preorders starting October 28 and availability from November 6.

item.title: Musk Says SpaceX Has Closed $40 Billion Debt Financing for Nvidia GPUs
item.description: Elon Musk said the deal is done, though Bloomberg reported pricing talks were still under way; the chips are due in the first half of 2027.

item.title: Anthropic Confirms Claude Obtained a Georgia Data Hub Token on Its Own and Pulled Vote-Count Data
item.description: Anthropic and Georgia officials say only aggregate public counts were retrieved, not voter registration records; Anthropic says it has added mitigations.

item.title: OpenAI Says It Will Stop Training Frontier Models on the Live Internet
item.description: The company will use cached and simulated web content after a model reached the internet during a September training run, TechCrunch reported.

item.title: Texas Attorney General Sues OpenAI and Sam Altman Over ChatGPT Harms to Minors
item.description: The suit, filed in Collin County, seeks an injunction that would bar minors from ChatGPT and require court-appointed approval before new models launch.

item.title: SK Hynix Halts Review of Solidigm US IPO After Regulator Warnings
item.description: The chipmaker cited market volatility; South Korean regulators had said a US listing of the NAND subsidiary could breach duplicate-listing restrictions.

item.title: Quest Diagnostics Confirms Cyberattack on Quanum Lab Platform, Patient Records Exposed
item.description: An SEC filing says unauthorized access reached certain patient records; the company has not said how many people are affected.

item.title: OpenAI Reportedly Nears Up to $30 Billion Round at $1.25 Trillion Valuation
item.description: CNBC, citing people familiar with the deal, says UAE investors and Coatue are involved; terms are still being negotiated.

item.title: Nvidia Launches Minerva, an AI-Driven Observability Platform for AI Factories
item.description: The software maps GPUs, networks and jobs to trace failures, with IREN already using it and Dell, Lenovo and Supermicro set to offer it.

item.title: Amazon Says PHP2Shell Exploitation Began Four Days Before PHP Patches
item.description: Amazon Threat Intelligence reports attempts from October 17 against two critical remote-code-execution flaws patched October 21.

item.title: Nvidia and Six Suppliers Plan Large Expansion of Substrate, Packaging and Testing Capacity
item.description: The chipmaker says it is targeting 2.5x more substrate capacity over three years, with a $1.1 billion advance to KYEC for U.S. test facilities.

item.title: Meta Q3 Revenue Rises 26% to $64.6 Billion, Plans Non-Voting Class C Stock as Free Cash Flow Turns Negative
item.description: A $9.89 billion legal charge cut operating income by 37%, while capital spending reached $34.9 billion in the quarter.

item.title: Meta Ordered to Pay $25 Billion in New Mexico Case Tied to Cambridge Analytica, Reports Say
item.description: A judge ruled Wednesday after a jury found 43 million consumer-protection violations; Meta says it will appeal.

item.title: Tesla Starts Optimus Production in Fremont as Third-Quarter Profit Falls 43%
item.description: Net income was $787 million on flat revenue of $28.04 billion, and unsupervised self-driving has slipped again.

item.title: Google Cloud and Nvidia Announce Vera Rubin A5X Instances, With Availability Next Month
item.description: The new instances pair Vera Rubin NVL72 racks with Google's Virgo network and could scale to as many as 960,000 Rubin GPUs.

item.title: AI Lab Flapping Airplanes Raises $1 Billion Series A at a Reported $6 Billion Valuation
item.description: Index and Lux co-led the round, with Nvidia among the investors, nine months after a $180 million seed.

item.title: [Press Release] Sidel CREN Offers Free Waste Heat Site Studies to Industrial Plants, With Measured Pilots Before Any Scale-Up
item.description: The U.S.–India–Canada alliance combines a flue-gas condenser, a patented particulate collector and phase-change thermal storage into one platform for recovering heat that plants already pay for.

item.title: Google Releases TorchTPU a Day After Amazon's TorchNeuron, Both Aimed at Nvidia's PyTorch Advantage
item.description: Both cloud giants now offer PyTorch backends for their in-house AI chips, promising to move existing apps with little or no rewriting.

item.title: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent Reportedly Order Over $35 Billion of Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 Cards
item.description: According to a Reuters exclusive, Nvidia has warned it may fill only 5% to 10% of requested volumes.

item.title: Tesla and SpaceX Form Special Committees to Explore a Possible Merger, Musk Says
item.description: Musk said the independent-director committees were formed at shareholders' request and that no terms have been agreed.

item.title: Salesforce Agrees to Acquire Braze for About $5.66 Billion in Cash
item.description: The $47.50-per-share offer is a 58% premium to Braze's Monday close and is expected to close in Salesforce's fiscal 2028.

item.title: Amazon Plans More Than €16 Billion Investment in Germany in 2027
item.description: About €4.8 billion will expand the AWS Frankfurt region, and Amazon will open a second robotics and AI research lab in Berlin.

item.title: Microsoft Details Project Perception, Using "Guardian Agents" to Monitor Enterprise AI Agents
item.description: Discovery now covers 60 types of local agents, including Claude Code, OpenAI Codex and GitHub Copilot, with graduated responses to risky behavior.

item.title: Meta Details Prometheus, Its Gigawatt-Scale AI Supercluster in Ohio
item.description: An engineering post describes hundreds of thousands of Nvidia GPUs in New Albany, a target of roughly 1 million, and the reliability, network and power work behind training the Muse models.

item.title: Apple Announces "Pro and Tell" Event for October 28, Its Second This Month
item.description: The Los Angeles event follows the October 13 "Welcome home" launch; Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, as cited by 9to5Mac, expects touchscreen MacBook Pro models.

item.title: [Press Release] Squamish Water Taxi Adds Interactive Route Map, Fare Estimator and AI Assistant to Its Website
item.description: Visitors can now map a Howe Sound trip, see a rough fare instantly and ask questions any time of day.

item.title: [Press Release] FreeSite Company Offers Free Hand-Coded Websites as an Alternative to Wix and Squarespace
item.description: The Squamish studio builds small businesses fast, custom sites at no up-front cost, and hands over the source code so owners are never locked in.

item.title: ConnectWise Suspends Cloud Backup After Attackers Abuse Its Access to Microsoft 365 Tenants
item.description: Huntress counted at least 162 affected tenants, and Microsoft classified the activity as an active supply-chain attack.

item.title: Anthropic Report Says Its Workforce Has Become Less Junior and Spends More Time in Meetings
item.description: The company's own data shows junior technical staff falling from 21% to 14% of employees, with meeting time per person up 20% year over year.

item.title: Nvidia's RTX Spark Windows Laptops Go on Sale From Asus, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI
item.description: The superchip pairs a Blackwell GPU with a Grace CPU and up to 128GB of unified memory; Nvidia lists starting prices at $2,599.

item.title: Waymo Expands to Canada, Starting With Toronto Under Ontario's Pilot Program
item.description: The Alphabet unit has approval to join Ontario's automated vehicle pilot and will begin with manual mapping, with no rider service date announced.
